name: adproject-coverage-tools
description: Coverage gate tooling for the adversarial dogfooding stack (see docs/Internal/Testing/ADVERSARIAL_DOGFOODING_100PCT.md)

scripts.test:cov: c8 --all --include 'coverage/*.mjs' --include 'site/*.mjs' --include 'ui-ux/*.mjs' --include 'content-guard.js' --exclude 'coverage/test/**' --exclude 'site/test/**' --exclude 'ui-ux/test/**' --report-dir coverage/coverage --reporter json-summary --reporter lcov --reporter text node --test coverage/test/ site/test/ ui-ux/test/
